name: model-router
description: Classifies each turn as mechanical, ordinary or hard and routes it to a matching model and reasoning effort, logging every decision.

routeEffort.title: Route reasoning effort
routeEffort.description: Lower effort for confidently mechanical turns and raise it for hard ones. A top-level effort change invalidates the cached messages for that request.

switchMainModel.title: Switch the main model
switchMainModel.description: Send each turn to its tier's model (hard → Opus 5.5, ordinary → Sonnet 5.5, mechanical → Haiku 5.5). Off by default: the prompt cache is per model, so every switch re-reads the whole conversation uncached.

cheapModel.title: Cheap model
cheapModel.description: Model for mechanical turns when main-model switching is on: the bottom rung of the Opus → Sonnet → Haiku ladder.

ordinaryModel.title: Ordinary model
ordinaryModel.description: Model for ordinary turns when main-model switching is on: the middle rung.

strongModel.title: Strong model
strongModel.description: Model for hard turns when main-model switching is on: the top rung. Nothing above Opus is ever used.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: laya: the local Laya decision server (no API cost, ~0.5s warm). model: a Claude model (classifierModel).

layaUrl.title: Laya server URL
layaUrl.description: Base URL of laya-serve; the router posts to <url>/v1/systemone.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: Claude model that classifies each turn when classifier is "model".

mechanicalEffort.title: Effort for mechanical turns
mechanicalEffort.description: Never raises effort: applied only when it is below the session's.

hardEffort.title: Effort for hard turns
hardEffort.description: Never lowers effort: applied only when it is above the session's.
